status: EXPERIMENTAL. Vectors for a carrier binding that is not part of evidence-interop/0 and names no binding token. Every key is a test key derived from a public label; never use one for anything else.
provenance: spec-derived, constructed; no relay, directory or host was contacted

verifier.note: The verifier's own configuration (binding §6 V4, §7): the witness keys it accepts, when it reads the carriers (its time, and the first_use times), and its clock skew.

test_keys.note: TEST-ONLY. Ed25519 secret keys are SHA-256(label); responder and impostor are the interop-profile-v0 corpus's keys. Nostr secret keys are SHA-256(label) as a big-endian integer, reduced mod (n-1), plus 1; aux_rand is 32 zero bytes.

requirements.statement: The evidence record named by the request is served under a verified envelope.
The authorization carried in the evidence record verifies under its own signature method.
The recorded action was authorized by the principal the carried authorization names.
